$comment: Validation-only config: wide Kootenays extent at 90 m, used by scripts/validate.py to test the model against occurrence records. Not a foraging target area.

grid.$comment: Analysis grid. All layers are warped onto this before scoring. crs=null auto-selects the local UTM zone from the AOI centroid.

access.$comment: origin = where drive time is measured FROM. Change this to your own trailhead/home base; it is not baked into the pipeline anywhere else.
access.$comment_hike: Tobler's hiking function base speed; terrain penalty applied per-cell from slope.

imagery.$comment: Seasonal window for NDVI. Expressed as month-day so it applies across all `years`.
imagery.$comment_scenes: Clearest N dates in the window are composited. More scenes = better cloud-gap filling, linearly more download.

terrain.$comment: dem_source: 'copernicus' (30 m, global) or 'lidarbc' (1 m, partial BC coverage). Pluggable so LiDAR can refine top sites later.

sites.$comment: How scored cells are clustered into the ranked pins shown on the map.
sites.$comment_selection: 'percentile' takes the top (100 - score_percentile)% of the local score distribution; 'absolute' uses min_score directly. Percentile is the default because an absolute cut does not transfer between regions - in the West Kootenays 95% of scored cells clear 0.45.
sites.$comment_separation: Minimum distance between two site pins. Patches are split at their local maxima so adjacent high ground yields separate sites rather than one sprawling blob.
